end.parentNote: Pari practised naming non-metals, their states, and everyday uses such as oxygen in breathing, nitrogen in chips packets and fertilisers, chlorine in pools, and iodine in salt. They used classroom examples and observations to explain ideas. They asked how iodine in salt relates to iodine crystals; this was not resolved in the recorded turns. At home, ask them to sort non-metals into solid, liquid and gas groups and name one use for each.
